instruction: Candid action photograph, medium shot at eye-level. Under a covered outdoor pavilion with white metal trusses and blue pillars, two young men are sparring. On the left, the boxer in the blue tank top (R2) stands in a defensive stance with black gloves raised, facing right and looking at his opponent. On the right, the boxer in the beige t-shirt (R1) is positioned with his back to the camera, facing left in a boxing stance with gloves up. The two boxers face each other, preparing to engage. In the background, a blurred bystander sits on a chair. The scene is illuminated by bright, natural daylight with soft shadows.
